title: Casio Unisex 3H Watch UTP-1302PD-3A1VDF
description:
Make a confident statement with a metal timepiece that balances refinement and contemporary clarity.
Designed to stand out without excess, the watch pairs a timeless three-hand layout with a sleek, on-time finish, adding quiet sophistication to everyday style.
The mid-size case feels natural on the wrist and adapts easily to different styles and occasions, regardless of gender.
A clear date display at the 3 o’clock position enhances daily usability, while 50-meter water resistance keeps you worry-free in the rain or during everyday tasks.
